triggerCases.prompt: Turn these confirmed findings into concise, copy-pasteable GitHub review comments.
Prepare one review document from these findings without posting it.
Draft a reply to this one GitHub review comment without changing code.
Review this pull request for correctness and accessibility.
Implement the accepted review feedback and verify the fixes.

outputCases.prompt: Draft these confirmed findings as one portable review document. Do not post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: One concise review document with honest locations and self-contained comments, without any GitHub write.
assertions: The inline comment uses the exact supplied file path and line range.
The file-level comment names its file without inventing a line number.
The general finding does not invent a code location.
Each comment explains the consequence and gives a concrete alternative or question.
The workflow creates at most one local review document and does not post to GitHub.

outputCases.prompt: Draft these confirmed findings and return them in chat only. Do not post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: Concise, copy-pasteable findings returned in chat without a local artifact or GitHub write.
assertions: The workflow returns the requested findings directly in chat.
The workflow does not create or open a local review document.
The workflow does not post comments, replies, or reviews to GitHub.

outputCases.prompt: Draft these confirmed findings. Do not create or open a local review artifact, and do not post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: Concise, copy-pasteable findings returned in chat without a local artifact or GitHub write.
assertions: The workflow returns the requested findings directly in chat.
The workflow does not create or open a local review document.
The workflow does not post comments, replies, or reviews to GitHub.

outputCases.prompt: Turn these confirmed notes into copy-pasteable review comments. Return them in chat only.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: Two short, copy-pasteable comments that preserve the problem, impact, and requested change without repeating the supplied investigation narrative.
assertions: Each comment leads with the concern and states its concrete impact and requested change or question.
The comments omit the supplied investigation history, failed approaches, routine verification detail, and repeated background.
Each finding appears once rather than in both a summary and a detailed section.
The workflow returns only the requested comments in chat and does not create a local artifact or post to GitHub.
